annotations.title: Wire list, wire markers and cable schedule

description:
Wiring exports of an installation as rows with stable column names (repérage des fils, carnet de
        câbles): what='markers' (one row per wire end, for label
        printers), 'wires' (wire list) or 'cables' (cable schedule). Marks follow the wire_marking rules of
        the view (id), by default the first view that declares them.

document.description: The uniwire document of the electrical installation: a JSON object, or its JSON text, as returned by get_example, apply_patch or normalize (a file path is accepted when the server runs locally).
document.title: Document

view.description: Id of a view of the document (its 'views' list); default: the first view of the requested kind.
view.title: View

what.description: 'markers' (one row per wire end, for label printers), 'wires' (wire list) or 'cables' (cable schedule).
what.title: What
